# Submission Pack Structure — COR 01/2026/27 (Theewaterskloof Municipal Website)

> **ASSUMED STRUCTURE.** The official pack (and therefore its own
> returnables order and any fatal checklist page) is not in the registry —
> only the advert record is. The assembly below is the **MBD-default
> municipal order** from the SDK regime fixture plus the guide's municipal
> conventions (returnable checklist first, rates clearances for company and
> every director, Overberg-rule collation). Re-order to the pack's own
> checklist the day it is collected — the buyer's printed order always wins.

## Envelope and logistics

- Sealed envelope endorsed with bid number **COR 01/2026/27**, bid
  description, closing date **2026-09-18 12:00**, bidder name and address.
- Delivery to Theewaterskloof Municipality, 06 Plein Street, Caledon, 7230,
  before 12:00 — confirm tender-box location and copy count (original +
  copies is a common WC municipal demand) from the pack.
- No briefing per the advert record; watch for addenda regardless and
  initial every addendum into the pack (KILL-22).

## Master document order (MBD default, pending the official checklist)

**Section 0 — Navigation**
1. Bidder's index / returnable checklist as issued (if the pack ships a
   fatal checklist page, it goes here, every line ticked)

**Section 1 — Administrative returnables**
2. MBD 1 — Invitation to Bid: every field completed, total bid price
   **R2,179,056.00 incl VAT** on the face (illustrative 5-year schedule —
   re-total to the pack's actual term and escalation rule once known),
   signed with capacity stated
3. Letter of Authority / board resolution to sign
4. CSD registration report (full) + SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN
5. CIPC registration documents
6. B-BBEE Status Level Verification Certificate (SANAS) or sworn affidavit
7. **Municipal rates clearance — company AND each of the three directors**
   (certificates < 3 months; certified lease route where renting)
8. MBD 4 — Declaration of Interest: every question answered, all directors
   with ID and tax numbers, signed
9. MBD 6.1 — Preference Points Claim (PPR 2022): points per goal, signed,
   proof behind it
10. MBD 8 — Past Supply Chain Management Practices
11. MBD 9 — Certificate of Independent Bid Determination, signed
12. POPIA consent/processing form if issued (expected on a
    website/hosting bid)

**Section 2 — Pricing**
13. Pricing schedule on the OFFICIAL form, re-keyed line-for-line from
    quotation QTN-2026-00327: once-off redevelopment; content migration +
    accessibility/POPIA pass; training; then the **year-by-year hosting +
    maintenance schedule (Years 1–5, mock 5.0% annual CPI escalation —
    the typical 5-year shape per client domain knowledge; this advert's
    stated term ends 30 June 2029, so trim to the pack's actual term and
    escalation clause before pricing final)** — comprehensive,
    VAT-inclusive, no blank lines (KILL-09), total reconciled to MBD 1 to
    the cent. If the pack prescribes a CPA/escalation formula, use it
    exactly — substituting fixed rates for a prescribed formula is a
    KILL-ALT-OFFER disqualifier at several buyers

**Section 3 — Technical / functionality evidence (assumed criteria)**
14. Methodology: redevelopment, content migration, go-live and
    maintenance plan — mirror the pack's own scope numbering once known
15. Portfolio of comparable websites with **signed client reference
    letters** and live URLs
16. **Company profile / capability statement** (DERIVED slot — municipal
    website packs routinely list one among the technical returnables; the
    SDK's ICT-CAPABILITY worksheet was captured for exactly this pack
    family) — **SATISFIED by generated artifacts** for the fictional
    Umzansi bidder:
    - [`../company-profile/umzansi-company-profile-a4.pdf`](../company-profile/umzansi-company-profile-a4.pdf)
      — 4-page designed A4 profile, **GENERATED (designer engine,
      `designer-compliance`)**; brochure edition
      [`../company-profile/umzansi-profile-zfold-a4.pdf`](../company-profile/umzansi-profile-zfold-a4.pdf)
    - [`../company-profile/startup-os/output/business_profile.md`](../company-profile/startup-os/output/business_profile.md)
      — compliance-gated content profile, **GENERATED (startup_os
      engine)**, with its provenance/override log at
      [`../company-profile/startup-os/output/compliance_log.md`](../company-profile/startup-os/output/compliance_log.md)

    *Honest note: these demonstrate the slot filled by generated output
    for the fictional Umzansi profile. A real bid substitutes the real
    company's profile and evidence (real certificates, real project
    record, real references) — and re-verifies the slot against the
    official pack's own returnable wording once collected.*
17. CVs: web lead (BSc CompSci, NQF 7, 8 yrs) and team, certified
    qualification copies
18. Hosting specification: ZA data-centre residency, security controls,
    backup and disaster-recovery runbook, uptime SLA
19. Support & maintenance SLA: response tiers, patching cadence,
    escalation contacts

## Cross-checks before sealing

- Buyer's own returnable checklist (once collected) ticked line-for-line —
  WC municipal checklists are fatal ("Non adherence … will invalidate
  your offer", Bergrivier pattern).
- MBD 1 total = pricing schedule total = QTN-2026-00327.
- Rates certificates: all four (company + 3 directors) inside validity at
  closing.
- All forms are the OFFICIAL issued forms; the generated SDK pack
  (`03-bid-pack.html`) is the transcription worksheet only.
